$comment: Canonical category registry for iNWebTools — 8 main categories, 25 sub-categories.
This file is the SEED, not the live source of truth. On startup it is synced into
Once seeded, admins edit names, icons, descriptions and ordering through
/AdminDashboard/CMS/Categories, and those edits live in the database.
Why seed from a file at all: a fresh installation must come up with the full
navigation already in place, and the structure has to be reviewable in code review
and diffable in git. Why not keep it ONLY in a file: an operator must be able to
rename a category without a deploy.
The sync is additive and non-destructive — it inserts rows that are missing and
leaves existing ones untouched, so re-running it never overwrites an admin's edits.
Slugs are URL-visible and permanent. They are written out explicitly rather than
derived at runtime because a slug change breaks every inbound link and every
search-engine result for that page: deriving them would make an innocuous rename
Slug rule: lower-case, digits, single hyphens (enforced by a CHECK constraint).
'&' and ',' are dropped, not transliterated — 'PDF & Document Tools' becomes
'pdf-document-tools', which is what the URL specification calls for.
